title: Trial queue tally — personal sprint sheet
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal tracker for queued trial runs across small-sprint experiments — keep tiny table, rough notes, and immediate follow-ups. Not official metrics; ephemeral and rough.

Legend:
- p50/p95 in ms per request (end-to-end from SDK call to final token).
- cost_est ~ estimate per 1k tokens using current cost model (inc. GPU + infra)
- seq = max sequence length used for the trial request.
- q = quantization format (int8/int4/fp16)

Trial table (most recent at top):
| id | date | model | variant | q | batch | seq | tokens | p50 | p95 | cost_est | notes |
| T-077 | 2025-02-10 | rw-7b-v2 | baseline | fp16 | 1 | 512 | 1200 | 45 | 120 | $0.65 | baseline for convo, no cache |
| T-076 | 2025-02-09 | rw-7b-v2 | kv-prefix-cache | fp16 | 1 | 512 | 1200 | 32 | 95 | $0.46 | prefix cache ~30% p50 win, check cache hit ratio (low sampling) |
| T-075 | 2025-02-05 | rw-7b-v2 | batch-4 | fp16 | 4 | 512 | 4800 | 70 | 190 | $0.28 | throughput up but p95 worse for single-user latency; not acceptable for web UI |
| T-074 | 2025-01-30 | rw-7b-qint8 | baseline | int8 | 1 | 512 | 1200 | 58 | 150 | $0.38 | slight accuracy check needed vs fp16; decode diffs small on sample set |
| T-073 | 2025-01-22 | rw-7b-v2 | dynamic-batching | fp16 | auto (2-8) | 512 | varies | 40 | 130 | $0.40 | good burst handling; tune max-wait-ms to 6ms

Quick observations:
- KV prefix cache gives consistent latency wins for multi-turn scenarios (T-076). Need to instrument hit-rate per user-id.
- int8 quant reduces cost but adds small output differences; create small prompt-level eval (10 prompts) to verify semantic drift before any rollout.
- Batch-4 helps throughput but hurts tail latency severely for single-request pattern — consider hybrid routing (low-latency tier bypasses batching).

To-dos (next 2 sprints):
- [ ] Hook minimal cache-hit sampling (1 in 100 requests) into console traces (link to GH PR above).
- [ ] Run 100-sample semantic-compare between fp16 vs int8 variant (dataset: convo-smoke-2025-01).
- [ ] Prototype routing rule: route request with header x-low-latency to non-batched pool.
- [ ] Capture p99 and qps per-worker for T-075 to quantify throughput vs latency tradeoff.

Notes-to-self / friction points:
- When running batch experiments locally, remember to clear KV cache between runs or re-seed; otherwise hits bias results.
- Cost-estimates are rough — includes serving but not infra overhead (remove cloud egress if needed).
- Keep experiment ids in the trace logs as header: X-EXPID (easy grep).

Unresolved questions:
- What is acceptable p95 for our internal demo surface? Product asked ~120ms at demo time; currently close for small requests but spikes on batch/backpressure.
- For int8, need a short checklist on evaluation thresholds. Who decides acceptance? Tagging Mina for this.

Scratch logs (quick commands / snippets):
- sample trace filter: grep 'X-EXPID=T-076' /var/log/trace/*.log | jq '.latency' | stats
- run small eval: python eval/semantic_cmp.py --model rw-7b-qint8 --baseline rw-7b-v2 --prompts data/convo-smoke-2025-01.json --out results/t075-int8-vs-fp16.json

End of sheet.

(Informal — move important results to shared playbook when ready.)
